description: This PHP class `FormatWithEmployeeName` implements the `ValueFormatter` interface to format a value by retrieving an employee's full name based on their employee number. It utilizes traits for employee service access, indicating it's part of a system for handling employee data within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: FormatWithEmployeeName
classes.description: A class that formats values by replacing them with an employee's full name fetched via employee number.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the full name of the employee associated with the given employee number.
